sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 4 (check 3) and Internal Quality Checks row 4 (annotations all 'None'); Deterministic Checks A13 check-instruction-content.py, A14 check-instruction-hygiene.py
evidence: Read instruction.md (5 paragraphs, ends with a single newline) and all three /instructions notes in full. grep -iE 'TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder>|<[a-z_]+>|lorem|tbd|C-drive paths|/Users/|/home/|F:/|turing|claude|note to self|??' over instruction.md and environment/instructions returned no matches; a non-ASCII scan returned nothing (no smart-quote/mojibake debris). The template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' line is fully replaced. Manual review of all 530 unique lowercase word tokens across the brief and notes found no misspellings (proper nouns Kittle, Rowe, Anand, Pryce, Lloyd, Marsh, Sian, Gwen are consistent everywhere). Only container paths appear (/assets/seed_data.json, /instructions, /app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db) and each matches environment/Dockerfile (COPY instructions/ /instructions/, COPY assets/ /assets/, WORKDIR /app). Contradiction sweep: one clock (integration.md:7 '2026-05-12T11:00:00Z' = seed clock), one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11, five accounts matching seed roles), one seed path, one password; 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12' matches seed M-12 walled ['dev@kittle.test']; hold/delete rules agree between conversations.md:9 and walls-and-retention.md:29; signed-out rules agree between instruction.md:7 and integration.md:9. No duplicated paragraphs or author asides. The misspelled 'Landlords notice recieved.' exists only as an intentional prior version of seed message K-2 (edit-history data, consistent with 'People fix typos'), not in the brief. Adversarial angle: a broken app cannot exploit this row (prompt hygiene only), and no wording would mislead a conforming app. No dictionary tool (aspell/hunspell) was available, so the spell check was manual; the deterministic checkers A13/A14 were not run by me (owned by the deterministic reviewer).
